title: Participation & Attendance — Rule of 85 (Eligibility and Effect)
summary: Defines the optional ‘Rule of 85’ eligibility (age + years in Rotary) and its effect on attendance expectations. Members qualifying under this rule may be excused from standard weekly attendance requirements while remaining active and encouraged to participate in service.

loc.anchor_text: Participation and excused attendance; Rule of 85

text_excerpt: Members who meet specified age plus years‑of‑membership thresholds may be excused from weekly attendance while remaining active…

title: Admission/Initiation Fee and Dues — Club Authority and Limits
summary: Clarifies the club’s authority to set dues and any admission/initiation fee consistent with RI constitutional documents; aligns semiannual billing dates and modern magazine language. Any local initiation fee must not conflict with current RI policy or district guidance.
text_excerpt: Club dues and any admission fee must align with RI policy and the semiannual billing schedule…

title: Board Nomenclature — Use “Board of Directors” for Club Governance
summary: Sets the correct club-level term as ‘Board of Directors’ and references meeting and quorum provisions. Avoids confusion with the RI Board of Directors, which governs Rotary International, not the club.
text_excerpt: This constitution establishes a club ‘Board of Directors’ with defined meeting and quorum requirements…

title: Club-Level Review Scope — Prefer Club Constitution and Recommended Club Bylaws
summary: For Rotary club bylaw reviews, prefer the Standard Rotary Club Constitution (2025) and the Recommended Rotary Club Bylaws from the Manual of Procedure. Avoid citing RI Board of Directors provisions unless the clause directly concerns RI-level governance.
text_excerpt: When reviewing a club’s bylaws, cite the Standard Club Constitution and Recommended Club Bylaws first; only reference RI Board provisions if the clause concerns RI’s corporate governance…
